messages: Alex Chen: RCA published for the memory-pressure incident (2026-03-18). Link: https://redwood-internal.docs/rcas/incident-18025-memory-pressure. TL;DR: a leak in the KV cache path on runtime v1.3.2 caused sustained OOMs and autoscaler churn, ~45m of degraded capacity. OpsBot: Doc uploaded and pinned to #postmortems. Full timeline, root cause, and mitigation steps are in the doc. Priya Nair: Action-item highlights from the RCA: 1) Runtime leak fix (PR linked in doc) — owner: Jamal Ortiz — target: 2026-03-25. 2) Autoscaler cooldown increase from 30s->120s for r4 pools — owner: Maya Lopez — target: 2026-03-20. 3) Mem usage alert (p95 and sustained growth) + runbook update — owner: Priya Nair — target: 2026-03-22. 4) Add regression test for KV cache eviction under high-concurrency — owner: Eng Runtime — target: 2026-04-01. Jamal Ortiz: Acknowledged. I have a patch that removes the stale cache reference, tests locally passing, will open PR today and request review. Maya Lopez: I'll land the autoscaler cooldown change behind a feature flag and run a canary on a small pool tomorrow morning. Priya Nair: I'll update the alerting playbook and add the new thresholds + runbook steps; will also add a Grafana dashboard link in the RCA. Alex Chen: Follow-up checkpoint scheduled: 2026-03-30 10:00 PT (30m) — goals: verify leak fix on prod canary, confirm autoscaler behavior, sign off on alerts. Invites out to @eng-runtime, @eng-sre, @product-reliability. OpsBot: Follow-up meeting created and calendar invites sent. Maya Lopez: quick note — rolling restart of impacted r4 nodes completed during mitigation window; no customer-facing data loss. :thumbsup: Jamal Ortiz: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4567 — requesting review from @eng-runtime. Priya Nair: Please ACK this thread once you've read the RCA and owners noted. Reply with "ack". Alex Chen: Thanks everyone for the quick response. We'll treat action items as blocking for the next release until resolved. Closing thread after the follow-up checkpoint unless new items surface.
